findings.title: Inherited place becomes chosen allegiance
findings.claim: The later generation occupies an inherited place while redirecting its following from the received prayer practice toward appetitive objects, so the inherited line becomes a changed moral direction that reaches ghayy.
findings.mechanism: The focus succession forms meet the later-generation inheritance pattern in 7:169; the focus following verb meets the prayer-neglect and desire-following pair in 18:28; the desire noun meets the explicit desire-as-god formulation in 45:23; the loss verb meets prayer heedlessness and prayer preservation in 107:5 and 70:34; and the final noun meets the supplied contrast between right guidance and ghayy in 2:256. These contacts turn succession into an active relay whose direction can be altered.
findings.reader_payoff: The warning becomes legible as a failure of transmission and allegiance, not only as a list of four bad acts: a received practice can be allowed to disappear while desire becomes the guide and deviation becomes the named destination.
findings.containment: The focus still plainly says that a successor generation lost prayer, followed desires, and will encounter ghayy. The wider parallels sharpen that relation without identifying the focus group with any target group, without making every root branch active, and without selecting one historical referent.

epistemic.reason: The integrated candidate is anchored by a trusted cross-run publication and exact focus branches; the contextual connection rows supply exact target Arabic but explicitly withhold target morphology and carry no separate trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sonradan gelen, öncekinin yerini veya işlevini üstlenir.
branch_activations.carrier: The two focus forms of the succession root name those who come after and occupy a predecessor's place.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 7:169 supplies a later generation that inherits the Book and chooses worldly gain.
branch_activations.activation: The target's later-generation inheritance pattern meets the focus succession forms and makes inherited place a responsibility tested by what follows.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The generation in 19:59 is seen as a failed relay of inherited practice, not merely as a group that happens to come later.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not identify the focus generation with the people of 7:169 or make every succession reference a moral indictment.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiyle birlikte ya da onun arkasında ilerleyerek ardından gitmek.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form VIII focus verb carries the act of going after or following.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:28 places following desire beside a heart that neglects remembrance.
branch_activations.activation: The target's parallel following relation supplies a concrete direction for the focus predicate and makes the act more than neutral sequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Following in the focus becomes a directional act that can place an object in the role of guide.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus verb is not reduced to the target wording, and no physical route is asserted where the context supplies a behavioral one.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir iz, örnek, buyruk veya öğreti doğrultusunda davranmak ve ona uymak.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus following verb can carry adherence to a direction, example, command, or teaching.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:28 independently joins desire with the conduct of following it.
branch_activations.activation: The target's desire-following contact meets the focus verb's adherence facet and makes desire an adopted direction within the warning.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Desire is heard as a guide that has been taken up, replacing the inherited direction of prayer.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not grammatically name desire as a god or erase its plain object relation; the guide image is a contained contextual resonance.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: istenene yönelme; istek, istenen şey veya isteme gücü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin istediği şeye doğru içten yönelmesi ve onu istemesi dalın temel anlamıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus plural names the inward movement toward desired objects.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 45:23 depicts a person taking his desire as his god.
branch_activations.activation: The target's allegiance-to-desire image meets the focus desire noun and gives its object a governing direction rather than leaving it as an undifferentiated impulse.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The desires can function as the object of allegiance that redirects the successor group's life.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not say that every desire is blameworthy or use the target's god-language as its literal translation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey elden çıkar, yok olur veya artık erişilemez hale gelir.
branch_activations.carrier: The agentive loss verb describes something being allowed to slip out of reach.
branch_activations.activation: The prayer-specific heedlessness meets the focus loss carrier and gives the loss a maintained-practice dimension.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Prayer is perceived as something that can disappear from lived practice, not merely as an abstract item omitted from speech.
branch_activations.boundary: The loss verb alone does not specify one exclusive mode of neglect.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimse bir şeyi korumayıp onun kaybolmasına, yok olmasına veya boşa gitmesine yol açar.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form IV loss verb assigns agency for allowing a valued thing to be lost or wasted.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 70:34 describes people who preserve their prayers.
branch_activations.activation: The preservation counterpart supplies the maintenance axis against which the focus's agentive loss becomes legible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The successors' fault includes failing to keep a living practice in custody until it is lost from their line.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not make historical transmission the only meaning of the loss verb or add details about the group's exact practice.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: doğru yoldan sapma ve başkasını saptırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Doğru yolun karşısında yer alan bir sapma ve yanlış kavrayış durumudur.
branch_activations.carrier: The final noun reifies departure from a sound direction as the endpoint of the clause.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 2:256 explicitly sets right guidance against ghayy.
branch_activations.activation: The target's guidance-versus-ghayy opposition meets the focus endpoint and gives the final noun a directional contrast rather than an unspecified bad result.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The announced encounter is with a named deviation from right guidance, reached after the changed following described earlier.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus noun is not turned into a present-tense act of misguiding, and the target is not treated as an exhaustive definition.

findings.title: Deviation arrives as an encountered consequence
findings.claim: The closing future clause can be heard as an encounter with the result of deviation: the focus meeting verb supplies an event, while ghayy names the adverse outcome met there.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier yلقون meets the supplied future meeting of a promised day in 43:83, while the focus ghayy noun meets the supplied scene in which the misguided are cast into Hell in 26:94. The two contacts externalize the endpoint as something encountered rather than only a condition held inside the successor group.
findings.reader_payoff: The final warning acquires a destination-like shape: what follows neglect and desire is something that arrives as an adverse meeting and consequence.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that they will encounter ghayy. This does not equate ghayy with Hell, identify the target referents with the focus group, or import target-side morphology that the packet does not supply.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers and qualified branch records are exact, and both target ayahs supply exact Arabic through connection records; those records are discovery nominations without a packet trust label and without target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki kişi veya şey karşı karşıya gelir ya da biri ötekiyle rastlaşır.

branch_activations.boundary: The target does not identify ghayy with a day or establish an identical historical scene.

findings.title: Prayer carries a qualified heat pressure
findings.claim: The prayer word remains the named devotional practice, while the independently supplied Hellfire image allows its accepted fire-exposure branch to register as a contained pressure along the focus's consequence path.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the focus prayer noun. The exact 26:91 target places the misguided before al-Jahim, and the focus sequence itself links lost prayer to following desire and meeting ghayy; that contact lets the fire-exposure facet press on the warned path without changing the ordinary referent of prayer.
findings.reader_payoff: The loss is felt not only as absence but as exposure to a punishing heat at the end of the path, making the warning's consequence more tangible.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory analogical resonance. It does not translate prayer as fire, identify ghayy with Hell, claim that the focus directly names a fiery punishment, or displace the institutional prayer reading.

epistemic.reason: The fire branch and focus carrier are supplied exactly, and 26:91 supplies an exact fiery target surface; the contact is multi-step, the connection carries no packet trust label, and the unanchored HFT outlier is not used as proof.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ateşin yakıcı sıcaklığına maruz kalma ve ateşle işleme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlık ateşe girer, ateşin yanında kalır veya onun yakıcı sıcaklığını ve şiddetini çeker.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun names the established prayer practice and, in this accepted branch, carries exposure to the heat of fire.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 26:91 explicitly places the misguided before al-Jahim, the supplied Hellfire image.
branch_activations.activation: The focus prayer-loss-to-ghayy sequence meets the independently supplied fiery endpoint, allowing the fire-exposure facet to press on the consequence path.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A contained heat-pressure resonance accompanies the plain warning: neglect can be felt as movement toward burning exposure.
branch_activations.boundary: Prayer still names prayer; this does not assert a direct lexical equivalence between the prayer noun and fire or make the analogical pressure a sole meaning.
